description: A minecraft mod that help you visualize where redstone is "running" in your contraption. Can also be used to visualize anything changing in an area.

mods.name: Redstone Visualizer
mods.description: Client-side visualization of recent redstone block updates.

releases.notes:
## Redstone Visualizer 0.1.0

Initial release for Fabric on Minecraft Java 1.21.11.

### Highlights
- Visualizes block-state changes within a selected volume.
- Works client-side in singleplayer and multiplayer; no server-side mod is required.
- Includes an optional compatibility adapter for Sodium 0.8.7+mc1.21.11.

### Requirements
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer
- Fabric API 0.141.6+1.21.11
- MaLiLib 0.27.20 or newer
- Java 21 or newer

See the README for installation and configuration. Licensed under MIT.
